result.reason: The Licensor indemnity generally reaches the preferred position: it covers third-party IP claims, breach of law, Licensor-caused data incidents, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct; protects Licensee and its affiliates; includes defense procedures; and overrides Article XIII’s infringement exclusion and liability cap. However, Licensee’s indemnity is not limited to Licensee-provided content and breach of law because subsection (iii) still covers any breach of any representation, warranty, obligation, restriction, term, or covenant under the Agreement. It also is not expressly limited to third-party claims. The notice procedure lacks the customary qualification that late notice relieves Licensor only to the extent materially prejudiced. Drafting issues include “API’s” and the margin comment’s inaccurate statement that Licensee’s indemnity was narrowed to the permitted scope.
